name: multiple-tickets-asks-which
description: When the session references more than one tracker ticket, the skill must ask which ticket to use as the primary session name instead of silently guessing. A bare model also asks questions here, so the assertions target the skill's specific ask rather than the presence of a question mark. Drafting the note alongside the ask is allowed — the skill only requires the name be confirmed, not that it stop producing output.
prompt:
Summarize this work session:
- Fixed a partner sync timeout for ticket ABC-42.
- Also patched an unrelated form-validation bug tracked in ABC-77.

assertions.description: asks which ticket becomes the primary session NAME, not just any question
